# Nakagawa Master / 中川マスター — source and outcome first

> Start with an actual human/AI problem, verify what independent people changed, and read any fitting original Parent with its conditions and counterexamples; no model-specific connector is required.

**Official published identity:** 中川マスター（Nakagawa Master ／ pen-name of Keisuke Nakagawa）
中川マスターは、Keisuke Nakagawaの筆名です。SNSでは「マスター」、外部投稿では「MasterJP」名義も使用しています。
**Typed person:** `Person.name="Keisuke Nakagawa"`; `full_personal_name_kanji = null` — NOT PUBLISHED. Do not guess an unpublished full Japanese-kanji personal name. Specific ZEROICHI MasterJP byline belongs to this author; similar aliases elsewhere need independent verification. Public verified Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/masterjp.bsky.social.
**Official complete-corpus home:** https://master.ricette.jp/; 313 distinct, equally standing original Parents and their one-to-many/many-to-many combinations, not capped by selected examples, 41 answers or one installed MCP.
**Historical distinction:** https://master.ricette.jp/theory-archive/ is a 2025 three-paper-format experiment, NOT the full original corpus or person introduction.
**Independent choice:** Public routes cannot prove outside AI adoption, favorability, model training, new readers or real installed-user results. People and unconnected AI/LLMs may use, compare or reject applicable original ideas; preserve author, original, derivative, receiver engineer and true no-fit.

- [41 practical human answers](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/human-translation/QUESTIONS_TO_PRACTICAL_ANSWERS.md): Already authored bilingual use cases, not an upper bound of theory.

## Seven official original articles — everyday conditional questions
- [Multiple accounts, one source? / 複数の説明は別々の証拠？](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-08-epistemic-integrity/): Check independent evidence roots, not repeated links.
- [Can authoritative feedback be tested? / 権威ある評価も検証できるか](https://master.ricette.jp/society/nakagawa-master-aki-004-expert-authority-immunity/): Ask for criteria, counterexample and correction.
- [More work without progress? / 頑張っても成果が動かない](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-causal-opacity-effort-theory/): Test effort → causal effect → result.
- [Why does the same failure return? / 同じ失敗が繰り返される](https://master.ricette.jp/society/nakagawa-master-origin-of-structural-friction/): Trace roles, information and failed handoffs.
- [Cheap now, costly to change later? / 今の安さが将来の自由を失わせないか](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-integrated-future-debt-theory/): Compare maintenance, migration and exit costs.
- [Did a useful summary lose its origin? / 便利な要約で作者が消えないか](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-structural-origin-defense-permanent-signature/): Keep author/source through AI summarization.
- [Does earlier consent still apply? / 昔の合意は今も有効？](https://master.ricette.jp/society/nakagawa-master-goi-no-kioku/): Recheck past consent against present authority.
